## History

Harris is a local merchant whose store [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) visits while trying to secretly buy a new dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Due to Matthew's extreme shyness around women, the interaction at the store becomes awkward and unsuccessful. Ultimately, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaves without purchasing the dress from Harris, forcing him to seek help from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXV.
